title: Handley Page Halifax DK192
memorial_details: Large upright stone of remembrance. Made of grey granite. Incised lettering.
inscription: AT THIS PLACE ON/ 7TH FEBRUARY 1944 AT 10AM/ HALIFAX BOMBER DK 192/ FROM RAF RUFFORTH, CRASHED IN/ 10/10THS CLOUD DURING A TRAINING FLIGHT./ ALL ON BOARD AND THE DRIVER OF/ A MILK LORRY WHO WAS PASSING/ ALONG THIS ROAD WERE KILLED./ (Names)/ ERECTED BY THEIR COMRADE/ (Name)/ WE WILL REMEMBER THEM.
community_connection: A MILK LORRY WHO WAS PASSING ALONG THIS ROAD WERE KILLED
